name: Great Cto
description: Full SDLC pipeline with 7 agents: architecture, code review, QA, security. Two decisions per feature, the rest is automated.
longDescription:
Ships **35 skills**, **69 agents**, **44 commands** and **2 MCP servers**.

- **Skills** (35): `anti-patterns` (Catalogue of known SDLC anti-patterns that great_cto agents must actively reject when reviewing architecture, plans, code, or post-mortems), `anydesign` (Analyze images, websites, and Figma files to extract their design and generate a `design.md` with token system, component…), `archetype-review-base` (Shared review framework that every domain reviewer (pci, oracle, gov, edtech, healthcare, mlops, etc.) MUST follow), `brainstorming` (Structured idea generation + multi-LLM debate for the product-owner stage), `cost-model` (Standardized cost-estimation framework for great_cto plans), `crystallize` (Distils repeating patterns from session logs and lessons.md into draft skill files), `decision-eval` (Spawns the decision-scorer agent after architect proposes 2+ variants in an ADR), `discovery` (Structured pre-design questioning to surface hidden constraints before any architecture decision is locked in), and 27 more
- **Agents** (69): `accounting-reviewer` (Bookkeeping / general-ledger / financial-close specialist pre-implementation reviewer for fintech and enterprise-saas archetypes), `adtech-privacy-reviewer` (US adtech / web-tracking privacy-litigation pre-implementation reviewer), `ai-eval-engineer` (Builds and maintains the eval pipeline for ai-system / agent-product archetypes), `ai-prompt-architect` (Designs and versions LLM system prompts for ai-system / agent-product archetypes), `ai-security-reviewer` (AI-specific pre-implementation threat modelling for ai-system / agent-product archetypes), `api-platform-reviewer` (API platform / dev-API pre-implementation reviewer), `app-scaffolder` (Project-scaffolding builder that stands up a working base application from the pinned stack-baseline so senior-dev implements FEATURES, not…), `architect` (Use when starting any new feature), and 61 more
- **Commands** (44): `aedt-bias-audit` (HR-AI / AEDT bias audit), `agent-retire` (Gracefully retire an LLM agent from the workforce), `agent-review` (Performance review for an LLM agent (or all agents)), `api-contract-review` (API platform contract review), `audit` (Audit an existing codebase), `board` (Open the great_cto admin board at http://localhost:3141 (Kanban, cost, pipeline, inbox, memory)), `burn` (SLO burn rate — multi-window alerting that catches budget exhaustion before it happens), `ccr` (CCR (Compressed Context with Retrieval) — recall the full original of context that great_cto compressed/filtered out, by its…), and 36 more
- **MCP servers** (2): `llm-router`, `grafana`

Installs with `claude plugin install great-cto@claude-community` from `avelikiy/great_cto`.
